verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents several in-product AI insight and suggestion features. Its marketing advertises plain-English questions about the business, such as "How's my cash trending?" and "Which months am I actually profitable?" AI Close uses agents to review transactions and surface discrepancies, an "ask AI" button suggests transaction categorizations, and Accounting AI runs prompts on top of the general ledger. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the plain-English Q&A insights feature (only a marketing line), detail on proactive insight generation beyond close discrepancies, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
